purpose: Record the actual historical inputs consumed by the implemented shrinkage candidate without confusing that implementation subset with the broader contractual component set of BSFM model 1.2.

fit_dependencies.name: prior target-event cohort membership
fit_dependencies.pit_requirement: For a simulated cutoff, only target outcomes that were authoritatively knowable by that cutoff may contribute to prior event counts. Later taxonomy/publication evidence cannot be back-projected.

fit_dependencies.name: historical departures by cohort
fit_dependencies.pit_requirement: The selected exposure vintage/reconstruction must be frozen and reproducible for the simulated cutoff; later revisions cannot be mixed silently with contemporaneous values.

fit_dependencies.name: cohort universe
fit_dependencies.pit_requirement: Cohort definitions and equipment mappings must be versioned before fitting and may not be altered after inspecting candidate skill.

interpretation: The implemented shrinkage estimator is a candidate fitting primitive/subset, not evidence that BSFM model 1.2 has dropped its other contractual components. A historical backtest using only this subset requires an explicitly versioned candidate/model specification before skill inspection. Until then, G3 for model 1.2 continues to include PIT obligations for its contractual components, including faa_sdr_precursors.
freeze_rule: This audit does not freeze or redefine the canonical predictor universe. Any reduced-universe candidate must receive a distinct versioned identity and frozen predictor specification before evaluation.
